# __DESIGN_SYSTEM_NAME__ agent entry point

Always fetch the configured current-release URL at task start. Follow its endpoint map; do not assume the site is hosted at the origin root.
Discard cached context when version, revision, schema version, or checksums change.
Select production components only from /ai/catalog.json records marked ready.
Private inventory is evidence, never a selection source or a default public endpoint.
Fetch the exact per-component context, source, styles, types, assets, tokens, content, rules, recipes, and migrations before implementation.
Do not deep-import, restyle canonical selectors, or invent undocumented reusable APIs.
Report missing capabilities and unresolved contradictions as design-system gaps.
